Pixel OS v1.5.4 — Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• True Zero-Frost Optical Crystal (0% Frost): Unblurred 540x1200 optical crystal refraction across 100% of Home Screen Dock, 'Q Search' Pill, and iOS Styler cards/preview when Glass Frost is set to 0% (zero milky veil, zero interior blur floor, full Snell meniscus bend & RGB dispersion)
• App-Close Dock Color Lock: Eliminates dock color shift & 1000ms snap-back when opening and closing apps via layout-locked wallpaper sampling, direct wide-color window-buffer rendering, and live MultiValueAlpha invalidation
• Standalone iOS Styler App (90Hz AGSL Liquid Glass) + Official iOS 26 'Sky' Default Wallpaper (1080x2400) + Pixel-Exact Uniform 62 px Home Screen Geometry + Pure Left-Right Navigation & 123 iOS 26 Icons
